game.title: Crash Team Racing Nitro-Fueled
game.blurb: Kart racing remaster of the 1999 Crash Team Racing, from Beenox and Activision (as RAWG lists them), released 2019-06-21 on PlayStation 4, Xbox One and Nintendo Switch. RAWG has no playtime yet. Genres: Action, Racing, Family. Chapters follow the game modes named in RAWG's achievement list.

notes: Backlog game, all-AAA pass: picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year across all genres (docs/PLAN.md section 2, genre filter widened 2026-10-23). Kart racer, so chapters follow modes rather than a story. There is no Steam list; chapters come from mode names in RAWG's achievement list (33 entries; RAWG's detail says 131, but only 33 come back from the endpoint), plus "race online with friends" and online leaderboards from RAWG's description, plus Grand Prix and kart-part page names linked from the Fandom page (for example "Back N. Time Grand Prix", "Nitro Tour Grand Prix", "Crash Team Racing Nitro-Fueled/Paint Jobs"). Several RAWG entries are marked "(CTR & CNK)", which probably means content from Crash Nitro Kart (it has a Fandom link); this was not checked further. StrategyWiki has no page under "Crash Team Racing Nitro-Fueled" or "Crash Team Racing: Nitro-Fueled". crashbandicoot.fandom.com answers the API under "Crash Team Racing Nitro-Fueled" with about 195 linked articles; names only were looked at, nothing copied.
